info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Notional Pooling Management API
info.description: The Notional Pooling Management API facilitates the consolidation of account balances across various accounts for effective cash management. This endpoint allows users to initiate the creation of a notional pooling arrangement, which is essential for optimizing liquidity and reducing borrowing costs. Ideal for corporate treasury departments, this API enables organizations to manage their cash flow more efficiently, providing real-time insights and enhancing financial control. Developers can leverage this API to integrate notional pooling functionalities into their financial systems seamlessly.

post.summary: Create a new notional pooling trade.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new notional pooling trade within the trade banking system. Please ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly in the request body to successfully execute the operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a notional pooling operation in the trade banking system. It contains the necessary parameters and data required to successfully execute the operation.
